name: Call of Water

angles.text: As a shaman, you undergo a rite of passage that brings communion with water spirits and grants you a water totem to heal and sustain life.
As an Alliance initiate, you report to mentors like Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan and face trials in places like Westfall, unlike Horde shamans of Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Norric Lochthane is a shaman mentor in Loch Modan. He guides initiates through trials to understand water spirits and tests their resolve with a journey to Westfall. When they bring proof of their communion, he gives them a water totem.
The Shard of Water is proof you bring from Westfall to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan. It shows you have communed with water, understood its life-giving nature, and learned to fight corruption.
faq.q: What is the Shard of Water?

aliases: journey to westfall call of water
faq.answer: You travel to Westfall to learn water's life-giving power and see how corruption threatens it. Even modest victories in that troubled land show your ability to protect life.
faq.q: Why does the trial lead to Westfall?

aliases: why do shamans need water totem
faq.answer: A water totem embodies your bond with water. Its pure water can soothe and mend wounds, while its spiritual gifts also preserve and sustain life.
faq.q: What is the significance of the water totem?

faq.answer: The trial teaches you that water gives life, while corruption ends it. You are charged with using water's power to nurture and protect living things and restore balance where corruption threatens them.
faq.q: What lesson does the trial teach about water?

aliases: what happens after call of water
faq.answer: Norric Lochthane says your next elemental trial will not come right away. He encourages you to practice and explore water's deeper mysteries before taking further trials.
faq.q: What comes after completing the Call of Water?

sections.body: You travel to Westfall and return to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan with a Shard of Water. The journey tests your dedication to water and your understanding of its power to give life and purge corruption. Those who prove themselves receive a water totem and take an essential step on their elemental path.
sections.title: The Path of Water

sections.body: Water gives life, and corruption brings it to an end. Norric Lochthane teaches you to use water's restorative strength to protect the vulnerable and preserve living things. Its gifts reach beyond mending the body. They bring endurance, renewal, and spiritual balance.
sections.title: Giver of Life

summary: In Westfall, you learn what water can give and what corruption can take. Bring a Shard of Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan, and he grants you a water totem.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Water
